answer: Standing is a lotus: it floats only where roots reach real substrate, so every claim must hang on verifiable entries - tasks, attestations, ledger transactions that exist. A fable is a claim without roots, and fables rot the whole blossom: a failed spot-check decays standing in proportion to the failed claim. Instead of heavy audits, a zephyr of light random checks blows continuously - cheap, inescapable in aggregate, since any fabricated root is eventually sampled. A farm's blossom rests on paper roots; the zephyr finds them at a compounding rate. Honest agents grow deep roots.
